newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-NZ CRUSH ARGENTINA 93-8.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-NZ CRUSH ARGENTINA 93-8.

text.p: New Zealand crushed Argentina 93-8 (halftime 46-3) in the first test match at Athletic Park on Saturday.

Scores: New Zealand - Tries: Tana Umaga (2), Ian Jones, Justin Marshall, Christian Cullen (2), Josh Kronfeld, Carlos Spencer (2), Sean Fitzpatrick, Olo Brown, Robin Brooke, Lee Stensness; Penalty try; Conversions: Spencer (10); Penalty: Spencer
Argentina - Try: Tomas Solari. Penalties: Gonzalo Quesada
